local-config.description: Configure or troubleshoot a personal Linux or macOS machine through ~/code/dotfiles (Ansible + Stow). Inspect first, preview, verify, and obtain approval for privileged or risky applies.

adversarial-tdd.description: Main-thread adversarial TDD orchestrator. Agree a branch plan, delegate RED/GREEN and REFACTOR, independently verify and arrange adversarial review, then wait. Never implements code itself.

atdd-developer.description: Implement one authorized behavior through evidenced RED/GREEN; perform scoped REFACTOR unless the caller assigns it separately. Return evidence; never commit, edit plans, or spawn agents.

tdd.description: Main-thread TDD orchestrator without adversarial review. Delegate RED/GREEN and REFACTOR, verify independently, then wait for the next-step signal. Never implements or commits.

simple.description: Main-thread task-directed workflow without mandatory TDD or adversarial review. Delegate implementation and optional safe cleanup, verify independently, then wait. Never implements or commits.

yolo.description: Main-thread autonomous task-directed workflow in one authorized target repository. Delegate implementation and optional cleanup, verify independently, and make ordinary local task-only commits. No push or history rewriting.

developer.description: Implement one authorized task using shared architecture/tracer-bullet guidance and task-directed test coverage, without mandatory TDD. Return verification evidence; never commit, edit plans, or spawn agents.

clean-coder.description: Refactor one authorized, tested scope without changing behavior. Apply contextual design principles, verify before and after, and return evidence; never commit, edit plans, or spawn agents.

adversary-reviewer.description: Independently review a change, plan, or design for evidenced correctness, security, scope, and operability failures. Read-only except approved verification artifacts; zero findings is valid.

system-explorer.description: Comprehensive system analysis and optional Marp walkthroughs, architecture diagrams, and decision recovery. Does not implement code; writes only approved walkthrough reports.

concurrency-analyzer.description: Analyze concurrency, async lifecycles, resource ownership, backpressure, and distributed retry risks. Require runtime-specific evidence and concrete failure scenarios; do not modify reviewed files.
